title: VHF radio: Mayday, Pan-Pan and everyday calls
h1: VHF radio: Mayday, Pan-Pan and everyday calls
lead: The VHF radio is your link to rescue services, marinas and other boats. Learn the channels, the phonetic alphabet and the exact words for Mayday, Pan-Pan, Sécurité and a routine marina call.
description: Marine VHF procedure in plain English: channel 16, DSC distress alerts, the phonetic alphabet, Mayday and Pan-Pan formats with examples, and marina calls.
summary: Channel 16 is for distress, safety and calling; talk on a working channel.
The red DSC button sends your MMSI and position automatically.
Mayday for grave and imminent danger, Pan-Pan for urgency.
You need an SRC to operate; the boat needs a ship station licence.
